name: zoom
description: Reads, queries, and safely plans typed mutations for the documented Zoom Meeting API surface.

risk.read: external Zoom Meeting API reads with bounded page sizes and redacted fixture replay
risk.write: typed Zoom Meeting API mutations only; reverse ETL requires plan, preview, approval, execute, with destructive confirmation for deletes
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan → preview → explicit approval → execute; fixture-only certification is not a live-provider claim
